The '''HyperMatter Storage Facility''' was a storage facility in the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]], a [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] refinery on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Galactic War]], [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|forces]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] raided the facility to replenish their own reserves.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HyperMatter Storage Facility is the site of the Imperial mission "Hypermatter Directive," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 along with the rest of the Black Hole.<ref name="TOR" />
